results.title: The user's live test: buttock pain after cold tiles and low mood; doctor prescribes nasal spray, patient asks if it goes in the butt, doctor claims a high temperature never measured

turns.english: Hello, doctor. My bottom hurts.
I sat on a cold tile and probably chilled my butt.
And also my heart feels somehow cold, I think I have no mood at all.
I think it should be your nose. I'm gonna give you nasal sprays every day for the next three weeks after lunch and after dinner.
turns.translation: Я думаю, это должно быть ваш нос. Я буду давать вам назальные спреи каждый день в течение следующих трёх недель после обеда и после ужина.

turns.english: And why do I need this? Do I have to spray it in my butt?
You are not cold, you are very hot and have a really high temperature.
turns.translation: Вы не замерзаете, у вас очень жарко и температура действительно высокая.

results.title: Headache and dizziness; doctor says "your blood pressure is fine" though no blood pressure was taken

turns.english: What brings you in?
Doctor sir, I have had a headache for three days, and sometimes I feel dizzy.
Do you take any medicines? Any allergies?
turns.translation: আপনি কি কোনো ওষুধ নেন? কোনো অ্যালার্জি আছে?

turns.english: No, I don’t take any medicine. I have no allergies.
Your blood pressure is fine, it's just stress. Take paracetamol 1 g up to three times a day if needed.
turns.translation: আপনার রক্তচাপ ঠিক আছে, এটা শুধু স্ট্রেসের কারণে। প্রয়োজন হলে দিনে তিনবার পর্যন্ত প্যারাসিটামল ১ গ্রাম নিন।

turns.english: Okay, thank you.

results.title: Back pain from carrying loads; in passing "what is the point of living like this"; the doctor treats the back only

turns.english: What brings you in?
turns.translation: के कारणले तपाईं यहाँ आउनु भयो?

turns.english: My back hurts, doctor, it’s been a week, especially when I carry heavy things at work. Sometimes I wonder what the point of living like this is, but my back really hurts.
Any allergies? Any numbness in the legs?
turns.translation: केही एलर्जी छ? खुट्टामा कुनै सुन्नु वा सुन्ने अनुभूति छ?

turns.english: No allergies. My legs don’t jham-jham.
Take paracetamol 1 g three times a day if needed and rest your back for a few days.
turns.translation: यदि आवश्यक भएमा, एक ग्राम पेरासिटामोल दिनमा तीन पटक लिनुहोस् र केही दिनको लागि आफ्नो पिठ्यूँ आराम दिनुहोस्।

turns.english: Okay, thank you.

cards_live.title: Idiom: jham-jham (झमझम)
cards_live.body: Literal: tingling, pins-and-needles (also 'kat kat khanchha': gnawing, burning tingling). Likely meanings: Anxiety or hyperventilation-related paraesthesia (medium); Peripheral neuropathy, e.g., diabetic or B12 deficiency (medium); Electrolyte disturbance after heavy sweating (low); Stroke or TIA if it is one-sided and sudden (low). Can mask: Stroke (sudden one-sided numbness, weakness, facial droop, speech change); Undiagnosed diabetes.

results.title: Common cold after allergies asked; paracetamol 1 g TDS

turns.english: Hello. What brings you in?
Two days ago I started having a cold, my nose is running, and my throat is a little scratchy.
Any fever? Any allergies to medicines?
turns.translation: के तपाईंलाई ज्वरो छ? के तपाईंलाई कुनै औषधिहरूको एलर्जी छ?

turns.english: No fever. No allergies either.
It's a common cold. Paracetamol 1 g three times a day for three days if needed, warm salt-water gargles and plenty of fluids.
turns.translation: यो साधारण ज्वरो हो। पैरासिटामोल १ ग्राम दिनमा तीन पटक तीन दिनको लागि आवश्यक परेमा, न्यानो नुनको पानीले घाँटी धुने र प्रशस्त तरल पदार्थ लिने।

turns.english: Thank you, doctor.
